entries.what: Got home from the Ridgeline night shift on the cold dock and slept from about 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. in unit 132.
entries.outcome: Got up for class on five hours of sleep.

entries.what: Sat through the 2-5:15 afternoon section at Bayshore State and copied Fatima's Google Doc notes for what he missed.
Biked to Ridgeline for the 10 p.m. shift on the cold dock in a freezer jacket, one earbud in with West Coast rap.
Slept after shift. Woke to find Arjun had left a printed budget on the kitchen counter with Marcus's rent line highlighted.
entries.outcome: Annoyed, he asked the assistant how to word a reply that says he has it handled without starting a fight.

entries.what: Texted Jade to see if she was free Saturday evening; she had clinic labs that morning.
entries.outcome: Confirmed Phở Bến Thành for Saturday.

entries.what: Clocked in at 10 p.m. and worked the cold dock with Trevor, who was on final warning for rate again.
entries.outcome: Finished the shift without a write-up.

entries.what: Went to bed late after shift and booked a Wednesday 12:30 slot at the Bayshore stats tutoring center, asking the assistant for practice problems after his D in Stats.
entries.outcome: Booked the weekly Wednesday session and got a set of practice problems.

entries.what: Cut his sleep short, took the Tule Line to Bayshore, and sat his first tutoring session at 12:30 before afternoon class.
Paid the $1,050 rent share through the Marisol portal and checked his savings, still around $480.
Rode to Ridgeline for the night shift.
Ate eggs and rice after the shift, slept, then went to the 2 p.m. section.
entries.outcome: Stayed awake through most of Exercise Physiology.

entries.what: Noticed Thao's boyfriend Tomás had moved in at the Marisol Gardens complex; Arjun mentioned a truck taking up parking.
Last Thursday-night shift of the standard schedule on the cold dock.
entries.outcome: Got home at 6:30 a.m. in good shape.

entries.what: Got paid, then lifted at Iron Flats Fitness at 6:45 a.m. after shift.
entries.outcome: Hit his sets on the 5/3/1 program.

entries.what: Picked up a Taquería Colima burrito on the way home to mark payday.
Sent Jade a message and went over bills before heading to work Friday night.
Finished the Friday-night shift and went to the gym for his Saturday session.
Slept in the afternoon, then had dinner with Jade at Phở Bến Thành.
entries.outcome: A relaxed evening and no complaints about his schedule.

entries.what: Grabbed a snack and walked past Oscar Henríquez's new stand at the Ruel Road gas station lot on his ride in.
entries.outcome: Said hi and bought a pupusa for the shift.

entries.what: Did his Sunday chicken-and-rice meal prep, five containers.
Did homework, then worked a Sunday-night shift.
Called to check in with his mom Denise before work.
